about: Per-passage lighting SCORES over the one P04 kit (looks are presets; a passage is a score of looks per bay over distance, with pools and gaps). Bays are WingPair ORDINALS inside the passage's PassageSettings range; the tool resolves ordinal -> CueGuid at run time from that range (never by label: P05 reuses labels). Tool: lighting_scores_apply.py. Plan: Docs/Conductor/LIGHTING_SCORES_PLAN_2026-10-04.md.

bulb_body_behaviours.modes_note: Every glass follows its OWN lamp's evaluated drama (LightAttachmentGuid = the paired lamp's minted GUID). STABLE: steady at the lamp's level. SLIGHT: glass-only shimmer, dips to 12% at 14 Hz; the lamp keeps its own light function. FAIL: flickers harder over the last 15 m and dies as the camera passes it, and drives the lamp too (a dead bulb casts no light). full_intensity -1 = the glass MI's own Intensity. Bodies without a derived emissive glass (no visible_mesh.material) are left default-off. SLIGHT glass-only and FAIL-drives-light are tool choices, not Gary's: flip flicker_also_drives_light here.
